entries.heading: ### Storefront.OrderService
entries.statement: Every placed order is recorded before payment is attempted
entries.counterexample: **Counterexample:** A payment attempted against an order that was never stored
entries.description:
Recording first is what lets a failed payment be retried.

# Why first

A payment with no order is a refund nobody can trace.

entries.heading: #### Storefront.OrderService.OrderRecord — What an order must hold
entries.statement: An order records what was bought, for how much, and when: placed | paid
entries.counterexample: **Counterexample:** An order row that cannot say who placed it

entries.heading: ##### Storefront.OrderService.OrderRecord.TranscribableReference
entries.statement:
An order carries a reference a customer can read
down a phone line
entries.counterexample: **Counterexample:** A reference that is a raw uuid

entries.heading: ##### Storefront.OrderService.OrderRecord.OrderExpiry
entries.statement: An unpaid order carries the instant it stops being reservable
entries.counterexample: **Counterexample:** Stock held indefinitely against an order nobody paid for

entries.heading: ## MoneyIsExactMinorUnits
entries.statement: Monetary amounts are stored as exact integer minor units, never as floating point
entries.counterexample: **Counterexample:** A cent that disappears when a total is split three ways

entries.heading: ## GuestCheckout
entries.statement: A visitor can check out without an account
entries.counterexample: **Counterexample:** An order with no way to reach the person who placed it
